sv.title: Svenske professorn: Epstein kan ha mördats
sv.summary: Tog Jeffrey Epstein verkligen sitt liv i sin cell? Nej, anser den svenske forskaren Anders Eriksson, som tillsammans med två andra rättsmedicinska experter granskat obduktionsmaterialet.

en.title: Swedish professor: Epstein may have been murdered
en.summary: Did Jeffrey Epstein really take his own life in his cell? No, says the Swedish researcher Anders Eriksson, who together with two other forensic experts has examined the autopsy material.
